tasks.title: Check Juju CLI version
tasks.instructions:
Run the Juju version command to verify your client installation:

```bash
juju version
```

tasks.title: List available clouds
tasks.instructions:
Inspect the clouds configured and available to your Juju client:

```bash
juju clouds
```

tasks.title: Inspect controller status
tasks.instructions:
View registered controllers and show details for the active controller:

```bash
juju controllers
juju show-controller
```
